sasha: Heads-up: onboarding pass for atlas-32k-q4 shows a reproducible KV checksum mismatch only after very long prefill + streaming. Reproducer + tiny logs below.

lee: Ack, can you paste the failing tail?

sasha: minimal tail (prefill=24000, seed=7):
```
[2026-03-22T20:05:41Z] PREFILL: wrote 24000 tokens to kv (shard0)
[2026-03-22T20:05:44Z] KV_CHECKSUM: shard0 checksum expected=0x7f9c got=0x7f1c
[2026-03-22T20:05:44Z] GENERATION: first mismatch token_idx=24910
[2026-03-22T20:05:44Z] MODEL: max_pos=32768, prefill=24000, inflight=1200, pos_mode=auto
```
Fails 4/4 runs. If prefill <= 20000 it's fine.

carmen: Interesting. Sounds like phase aliasing / pos-clip interplay at the 24k+ range. Q4 kernels may be computing rotary phase with a different pos->angle quant path, causing aliasing when stitched. Have you tried forcing `--pos-mode=clamp` or `--force-pos-wrap=none`?

sasha: Not yet. I'm running a clamp trial now. Command: `python tools/repro_kv.py --model atlas-32k-q4 --prefill 24000 --seed 7 --streaming=true --log=debug --pos-mode=clamp`

ravi: Also add a rotary dump: `python tools/dump_phase.py --model atlas-32k-fp16 --length 25000 --out pre_fp16.npy` and same for q4 then diff with `scripts/phase_diff.py`. If we see non-monotonic phase beyond ~24k that's the alias.

ci-bot: quick-check (run b9d2): model=atlas-32k-q4 prefill=24000 throughput=9.8 toks/s kv_mismatch_rate=2.1% reproducible=4/4 link: https://ci/rep/b9d2

sasha: Clamp run result: 3/3 clean. So forcing clamp avoids the mismatch. That points to pos->angle conversion divergence on the quantized path (alias vs clamp).

carmen: Good signal. Short-term mitigation: for q4/q3 models, set onboarding harness to `pos-mode=clamp` when prefill > 20k. Long-term: kernel team should ensure quantized pos->angle mapping preserves monotonicity vs fp16.

ravi: I'll push a small numeric test: generate pos angles for positions 0..32767 in fp16 vs q4 encode/decode and assert monotonicity and max delta < 1e-3. I'll open a PR with the test and attach the failing diff.

sasha: I'll open a ticket: "pos-alias: quantized pos->angle non-monotonic at high pos -> KV stitch checksum (atlas-32k-q4)" with repro and rotary diffs. Also adding a short-term gating rule in onboarding harness.

lee: One more ask: collect a hex-dump of the kv pages around the mismatch idx (idx-64..idx+64) and attach to the ticket; might help differentiate miswrite vs compute drift.

sasha: Will attach hex-dump and the phase-diff npy files. Thanks team. :+1:
